_about: Number windows on the pump corpus, hand-annotated by the orchestrator (2026-09-19). Coordinates are normalised [0,1] over the EXIF-oriented image; quad corners TL, TR, BR, BL in image space. rotationCW is how far to rotate the image clockwise for the text to read upright (absent = 0). text is what the display SHOWS - zero padding and the comma kept, empty when the window is unreadable. field: total | liters | unitPrice | board (a grade-price board cell that is not the transaction price). Precision: about +-1% of the image edge; the quads are an oracle for a locator, not a pixel-exact mask. Checked by scripts/pump-windows-check.py. Entry-level keys: notOnDisplay - fields expected.csv asserts (from the paired receipt) that the display does not show; csvDisagrees - the display shows a different number than expected.csv asserts, with the reason; legibility on a window - "partial" when the digits are only partly readable through glare. reviewed - true once a human has checked the entry in tools/pump-annotate (an entry without it was drawn but not confirmed). tracking - ok | bad, set in the annotator's Frames view after stepping through the still's Live record with the tracked quads overlaid (pump_reader.track); bad means the record's frames are skipped by the glyph extractor. Conventions: no window = the field is not on this display; a window with empty text = found but unreadable; unlit leading cells are never transcribed (no string has a leading space); a board cell can coincide with the transaction price (pump-007, pump-009). pendingWindows - true on an entry whose still is in the corpus but whose windows are not all drawn yet - none, or the reader's auto-placed ones with an asserted cell still missing (the truth is in expected.csv); the checker skips it, the annotator's save drops the flag. negative - the reason a display carries no number windows at all (text in the sum window). Per-window provenance: placedBy - who placed the quad (hand | auto | reader | tracker | template), written by the annotator when the box is drawn or edited; an entry drawn before the key existed was hand-drawn, except the reader's auto-placed pump-244..pump-281 batch and any still flagged pendingWindows, which are auto. zoom - the annotator's canvas zoom at the last quad edit.
